verdict.rationale: Orama ships its own AI answer engine (AnswerSession, ChatGPT-like experiences) that turns questions about indexed data into answers with sources, and Orama Cloud projects are built for RAG over your data sources. That gives AI-generated output from your data, but it is a developer-embedded Q&A feature rather than proactive insights or suggestions surfaced inside the product. Missing for 10: proactive insight or suggestion generation, an in-product (dashboard) surface for analyzing your own data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: turns a question into a straight answer with the sources behind it
AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website.
A project is a set of **data sources** that you want to use for RAG, search, or any other method of retrieval.
